correctness.rationale: For the repaired text, corrected the coordinate-parity ambiguity: all six permutations are used and exactly four sign triples per permutation satisfy the stated parity match. Restriction to even permutations would yield only 12 vertices. A standard-library rational-bracket calculation independently verified the real coordinate ordering, 60 shortest pairs, 5-regularity, 32 triangles and the exact labelled edge file. A direct-edge, integer histogram over every pair of complementary configurations reproduced every B_k and N_k; it fixes bit 23 off in 2^23 masks and adds their complements, checking every sector size against binomial(24,k). This uses neither frozen recurrence. Reduction H/J=60−2|δ(S)|−(h/J)(2k−24) and spin reversal reduce positive h to down-spin counts j≤12, and the two affine sector slopes in j are 2h/J−10 and 2h/J−2. They vanish only at 5 and 1 respectively. The census gives 18 at h=0 and throughout the low field, 201 from sectors 8..12 at h=J, 3 at the plateau M=8, 5302 at h=5J and 1 beyond it. No symmetry quotient is taken. The repaired geometric verification notes distinguish approximate original coordinate sorting/gap checking from exact distance equality and give an exact interval remedy; the theorem and labelled data are unchanged.
residual_risks: Independent replay checks the exact finite labelled graph and all spin states, not literature priority or other Ising models. Frozen uploaded scripts were inspected, not executed.

checked_sources: Frozen and repaired findings; arXiv:1107.2893v1 snub-cube section; comparison with October independence branch and later f72c9a2d66bb
value.rationale: The snub cube was already a finite benchmark for frustrated antiferromagnetism. The full constrained-cut classification supplies the ground states under every uniform field, notably the one-third plateau, exact coexistence at the low field, and its magnetization-resolved counts; these are useful exact benchmarks not determined by high-field saturation data or heat capacity comparisons. The fixed-size histograms also explain the lower envelope rather than only checking a few fields. Value is assessed for the frozen-date contribution, not for recomputing the earlier independence counts.
residual_risks: This exact finite magnetic classification does not by itself imply a thermodynamic or other-polyhedron theorem.
